mitdb.cross_db_overlap_note: Same institution pool (BIH Boston) as ltdb, sddb, svdb; cross-database subject non-overlap not independently verified.

incartdb.cross_db_overlap_note: St. Petersburg Institute of Cardiological Technics; explicit patient 1..32 labels in .hea.

ltdb.cross_db_overlap_note: Same institution pool (BIH Boston) as mitdb, sddb, svdb; 7 distinct age/sex records.

edb.cross_db_overlap_note: European ST-T Database (90 records from 79 verified subjects; 7 multi-record groups).

sddb.cross_db_overlap_note: Same institution pool (BIH Boston); shares underlying subjects with vfdb (DO NOT use vfdb as external test!).

svdb.cross_db_overlap_note: 0/78 .hea demographic comments and no published PhysioNet subject-ID table; 78 record-level IDs (subject uniqueness unverified).
